edges.reason: Constructor derives the admin account directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the admin state variable.
Untrusted msg.sender is compared against admin in the access-control check.
The adminOnly modifier performs the msg.sender != admin check and reverts.
adminOnly depends on the untrusted msg.sender value.
adminOnly guards entry into addPack.
adminOnly guards entry into start.
adminOnly guards entry into setAdmin.
setupOnly reads the isSetupMode state variable.
setupOnly guards entry into addPack.
addPack reads the caller-supplied addrs array.

addPack reads the caller-supplied maxs array.
addPack reads the caller-supplied _chunkNr argument.
Loop in addPack iterates over addrs using len = addrs.length.
addPack writes and deletes entries in the allowed mapping.
addPack mutates chunkNr via post-increment without overflow protection.
addPack mutates controlSum with unchecked += and -= operations.
addPack adds len to recordNum without overflow protection.
The chunkNr++ operation updates the chunkNr state variable.
The controlSum -= operation decreases the controlSum state variable.
The controlSum += operation increases the controlSum state variable.
The recordNum += len operation increases the recordNum state variable.
addPack executes the chunkNr++ increment inside the declaration check.
addPack executes the controlSum -= operation when removing old records.
addPack executes the controlSum += operation when inserting new records.
addPack executes recordNum += len after the loop.

setAdmin overwrites the admin state variable with newAdmin.
start sets isSetupMode to false.
Fallback function unconditionally throws.
